item.title: Malaysia defends 1979 map, rejects maritime claims including China – Mohamad Hasan
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Malaysian government has taken a firm stance to continue to defend the country’s territorial sovereignty based on the 1979 New Map of Malaysia and not to recognise any maritime claims by external parties that contradict it, including China.
